title: Recoverable edit form
description: Edit a value without losing work when saving fails.
requirements: Keep entered values after a failed save.
Keep controls reachable by keyboard and at narrow widths.
Reserve outer layout space for the material shell (--tz-pad) and its animated contour. Verify page overflow with normal motion; do not hide overflowing decoration to silence the check.
review: Is the next action clear in every state?
Does material decoration preserve readable content and hierarchy?
